items.source: Optionally add a depth field fieldName to each traversed document in the search path.
items.translation: 可选地，在搜索路径中的每个遍历文档中添加一个深度字段 fieldName。

items.source: Optionally limit the number of recursions.
Optionally add a query specifying conditions to the recursive search.
items.translation: 可选地，添加一个指定条件的查询到递归搜索中。

items.source: fieldName - must not be null or empty.

items.source: Set the name of the array field added to each output document and return the final GraphLookupOperation.
items.translation: 为添加到每个输出文档的数组字段设置名称，并返回最终的GraphLookupOperation。

items.source: Set the name of the array field added to each output document and return the final GraphLookupOperation. Contains the documents traversed in the $graphLookup stage to reach the document.
items.translation: 为添加到每个输出文档的数组字段设置名称，并返回最终的GraphLookupOperation。包含在$graphLookup 阶段中遍历以到达该文档的文档。

items.source: numberOfRecursions - must be greater or equal to zero.
